About Hind Scrap

India's Global Circular Materials Platform

Not a scrap dealer. A globally positioned secondary-raw-material sourcing, trading and supply network — connecting the world's recyclable resources with India's industrial demand.

Our Story

Built on a Simple but Powerful Insight

India is the world's second-largest steel producer — yet imports significant secondary raw materials without a structured, trusted global sourcing partner.

India also generates enormous quantities of recyclable materials that don't flow efficiently to the global buyers who need them most. Hind Scrap was founded to close both gaps.

"We envision a future where scrap is no longer seen as waste, but as a globally traded industrial resource — verified, graded, traceable and delivered where it creates the highest value."

Global Sourcing

We Source the World's Recyclable Raw Materials for India's Industries

Our global supplier network spans 20+ countries. For every grade — we find the verified source, arrange inspection, handle documentation and deliver to your facility.

🇺🇸

USA & Canada

World's largest scrap generators — HMS 1&2, shredded, copper, aluminium. Major ports: Houston, LA, New York, Baltimore.

🇬🇧

United Kingdom

Premium quality HMS and non-ferrous with strong documentary standards and one of Europe's most developed scrap industries.

🇩🇪

Germany & Netherlands

Engineering-grade non-ferrous, specialty alloys. Rotterdam as key logistics hub for European material sourcing.

🇯🇵

Japan & South Korea

Consistently clean, well-sorted ferrous and non-ferrous. Japanese steel scrap preferred by Indian mini mills.

🇦🇺

Australia

Major exporter of ferrous and non-ferrous scrap to Asia. Growing India-Australia trade makes this a key strategic market.

🇦🇪

UAE & Gulf

Structural steel, copper electrical, aluminium facade material from Gulf infrastructure build-out and major construction projects.

Logistics & Documentation

End-to-End Trade Logistics — From Origin Yard to Your Factory

International scrap trade is complex. We manage every step so your procurement team receives verified material, not paperwork problems.

🚢

Ocean Freight & Vessel Booking

Bulk vessel bookings for large consignments and containerised shipping for smaller lots — optimising freight cost and transit time. FOB, CIF or DAP terms negotiated per buyer requirement.

🏗️

Port Operations & Customs

Export customs clearance at origin, import customs filing at Indian ports, DGFT import licensing liaison, and port-level compliance for hazmat materials.

📋

Trade Documentation

Commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, Bill of Lading, MTRs, CoA, SGS inspection report, phytosanitary certificates — complete documentary package.

🚛

Inland Delivery

From Indian port to your plant or warehouse — bulk truck transport, rake movement for large consignments, and last-mile delivery across all major industrial cities and SEZs.

💱

Trade Finance Support

Guidance on LC structures, CAD terms, and connection to trade finance providers for buyers requiring working capital support on large consignments.

🔗

Shipment Tracking

Vessel tracking, ETA updates, port arrival notifications and discharge confirmations — keeping your procurement and inventory teams informed throughout the lifecycle.
